description: This script automates the generation of MDX documentation pages for Superset components by parsing Storybook story files, extracting metadata, args, argTypes, and configuration details, and then producing structured documentation including component controls, galleries, and import instructions.

methods.name: walkDir
methods.description: Recursively finds all story files (.tsx or .ts) in a directory and its subdirectories.

methods.name: findEnabledStoryFiles
methods.description: Collects all story files from enabled sources based on configuration.

methods.name: findDisabledStoryFiles
methods.description: Collects all story files from disabled sources for tracking purposes.

methods.name: parseStoryFile
methods.description: Reads a story file and extracts metadata such as title, component name, import paths, description, and source configuration.

methods.name: parseArgsContent
methods.description: Parses the args object content from story files, handling strings, booleans, and numbers.

methods.name: extractVariableArrays
methods.description: Extracts arrays of options or sizes from variable declarations in the source code.

methods.name: extractStringValue
methods.description: Extracts a string literal from content, handling quotes and escape sequences.

methods.name: parseArgTypes
methods.description: Parses argTypes definitions, extracting descriptions, options, and control types.

methods.name: extractBalancedBraces
methods.description: Finds content within balanced braces starting from a given index.

methods.name: extractBalancedBrackets
methods.description: Finds content within balanced brackets starting from a given index.

methods.name: propNameToLabel
methods.description: Converts camelCase property names to human-readable labels, handling acronyms.

methods.name: jsToJson
methods.description: Converts JavaScript object literals to JSON strings, handling quotes, unquoted keys, and trailing commas.

methods.name: extractDocsConfig
methods.description: Extracts documentation-related configuration such as sampleChildren, gallery, staticProps, liveExample, examples, and rendering overrides from story parameters.

methods.name: extractArgsAndControls
methods.description: Extracts args, argTypes, controls, and additional configuration for a component from story files.

methods.name: generateMDX
methods.description: Generates MDX documentation content for a component, including controls, gallery, import instructions, and live code examples.

methods.name: generateCategoryIndex
methods.description: Creates an index page for a category listing all components.

methods.name: generateOverviewIndex
methods.description: Creates an overview page listing all categories and components.

methods.name: generateTodoMd
methods.description: Creates a TODO markdown file listing skipped or unsupported components for future support.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates the discovery, parsing, and generation of documentation pages.
